design.authority: Existing Hollywood Goal/definition/strategy/command/event authority; LAX native tools expose the same actions.
design.states: Latest proposal is pending, adopted, rejected or deferred. Rejection/deferment does not change the adopted definition or accepted Work.
design.storage: One Goal projection field definition_resolution records exact latest revision/digest, decision, actual actor, explanatory public source and note; existing immutable command/event receipt owns the attributable transition. No additional service or Work ledger.
rules: Only existing Goal managers can reject/defer a proposal, with current Goal revision and exact latest proposal digest.
Acceptance requires the latest proposal adopted or explicitly rejected/deferred. No silent success with unresolved intent.
New proposal invalidates prior resolution. Adoption remains the existing exact revision/digest operation.
Rejection/deferment preserves selected strategy, accepted criterion bindings and original evidence. Adoption retains existing stale-work and coverage checks.
Planning wake cuts include exact resolution state; unchanged reads cause no model wake.
Dispositions are attributable planning decisions, not claims of human approval or semantic correctness.

capturedRollbackQualification.scope: Real completed disposable native Goal and Work with explicitly rolled-back lifecycle counterfactuals. Deterministic state/authority checks, not HTTP/native semantic proof.

httpQualification.callerCorrection: Command GET returns workflow/canonicalCommand.acceptedResult envelopes, not a direct contract property. Read original receipts to finish inspection; no resolve/create/source submission repeated.
httpQualification.scope: Authenticated real HTTP/PG state/receipt tests using disclosed nonexecuting human metadata-admin authority and source SDK forwarding. Not native-agent admission or model behavior proof.
httpQualification.cleanup: Only fixture Goal and source delivery cancelled, original command/event history retained.

oldAPIboundary.scope: Actual old installed server rejects the new action route before command admission. Not downgrade compatibility of new active policy state.
